name: Server Unreachable
description: We're a new and upcoming Minecraft server that supports both Java and Bedrock edition. Our server is aiming to give a close-to-vanilla feel while offering a ton of fun and extra features. In the future we are hoping to offer the following gamemodes: Survival (SMP), Skyblock, Prison (Classic) and Creative. Starting out, we will focus on the Survival/SMP server. Craftbit will be a community-focused server, meaning that our first priority will always be the community of the server.
